column1: # Calls to names that are obsolete on some SOLIDWORKS interface and current on another, whose
# receiver type the source does not say (Tests/ObsoleteCallsContract.cs). Exact counts per
# file|name: a new one is red. Type the receiver in the source rather than raising a count;
# a raised count needs a reason in the commit.
# Raised by rename window 3 (W3.1-bis.6, 5/10/2026), for one reason: the names of the project, not its code. The members counted
# below had Italian names, which the scanner never read as a name of the SOLIDWORKS API; they have English ones now (the name map
# has the pairs), and an English name such as Name, Value, Edge, Type, Entity, Face, Check, Close, Label or Text collides with a name
# that is obsolete on one interface and current on another, so the scanner counts the call. Every call is on a receiver of the
# project itself (a record of the bench, a node of the catalog, a lambda parameter, a static helper), the same receivers, in the
# same untyped places, as before the window: no call was added and none moved (same-il explains every IL difference by the map).
# The window renames and does not rewrite code, so the receivers are not retyped here: the counts are the ones the rename produces,

# Raised for brief R15 (26/10/2026): Oce.Solid.Agent.Core/StlMesh.cs|Add 4. Every call is List<T>.Add on a list of the mesh itself (a field, an out variable, a typed local); the scanner reads a declared type only without angle brackets, so a List<T> receiver stays undecided however it is typed.

# Raised for round 14 of report 8cd843 (27/10/2026): Oce.Solid.Agent.Core/BalloonSpreadOperations.cs|Value 1 and Oce.Solid.Agent.Core/DrawingViewOperations.cs|Add 1, |Value 1. Each is a KeyValuePair<string, ...>.Value of a typed foreach or List<string>.Add on a typed local; the scanner reads a declared type only without angle brackets, as for R15.

# Raised for round 15 of report 8cd843 (28/10/2026): Oce.Solid.Agent.Core/DrawingViewOperations.cs|Text 1. It is the namespace System.Text of «using System.Text.RegularExpressions;», for the Regex of UidOnManySheets; the scanner reads the segment of a namespace as a call.

# Raised for round 16 of report 8cd843 (28/10/2026): Oce.Solid.Agent.Core/TitleBlockOperations.cs|Add 7. They are List<string>.Add on the parameters warnings, missing and blank of OtherSheets and PropertyValues, and on an element of the local List<List<string>> viewsOfModel; 7 with notes.Add in FormatNotes, the loop of TitleBlockNotes moved into a function with the list as parameter. The scanner types only the receivers declared as locals with new.
